response.sql:
SELECT
  c.state AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_of_all_player_college_records
FROM player_college AS pc
JOIN college AS c
  ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
GROUP BY c.state;

assumptions.assumption: A blank state (empty string) and a missing state (NULL) are separate groups; SQL groups NULL values together.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat blank and missing states as one group.
alternatives.sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS share_of_all_player_college_records
FROM player_college AS pc
JOIN college AS c
  ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END;
